name: m-skills
description: A simple plugin for full-stack developers who use Claude for real work. Five commands are the everyday loop — brainstorm, plan, implement, review, document — with design, testing, docs, slicing, debugging, release and upkeep there when needed. Resolved per project instead of hardcoded.
